# KeyRote

> KeyRote is an enterprise-grade API Key Rotation & Load Balancer Proxy designed to transparently handle rate limits across all major AI providers.

## About

KeyRote sits between your application and AI providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini. It automatically rotates through a pool of API keys to bypass 429 rate limit errors without requiring changes to your application logic.

- **Founder(s):** John Varghese (J0X)
- **Type:** Developer Tool
- **Primary Language:** English
- **Target Audience:** Developers, AI Engineers, System Architects

## Key Topics & Expertise

- **API Key Rotation:** Transparently cycle through multiple API keys to maintain high availability.
- **Load Balancing:** Distribute API requests effectively across rate-limited endpoints.
- **AI Gateway:** A universal proxy for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, and xAI.
